name: Ie, Tatemasu!
source:
The action takes place in a small village on the west coast of Japan, where the construction workers are called from Tôkyô to build a house for a widower and his two sons.

[From [url=http://archive.insertcredit.com/reviews/ietate/]Insert Credit review[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在日本西海岸的一个小村庄，建筑工人从东京被召集到那里，为一名鳏夫和他的两个儿子建造一座房子。

[来自[url=http://archive.insertcredit.com/reviews/ietate/]插入信用审查[/url]]
